tbesh_html:
Beth-meon = "house of Meon"
a city in the territory of Reuben
Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)

strongs_1890.derivation: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); house of Baal of (the) habitation of (apparently by transposition); or (shorter) בֵּית מְעוֹןlemma בֵּית מעוֹן missing vowel, corrected to בֵּית מְעוֹן; house of habitation of (Baal);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: Beth-baal-meon. Compare H1186 (בַּעַל מְעוֹן) and H1194 (בְּעֹן).
